headline: Gold dips slightly today; silver flat at ₹1,70,000 per kg
summary: Today's gold move is small: 24K gold is down ₹54 per gram (about 0.42%) to ₹12,786, and 22K is down ₹50 to ₹11,720. Silver is unchanged today at ₹1,70,000 per kg. Over the last 7 days, gold has risen about 2.2% while silver has fallen about 2.9%, and both remain well below late-October levels, with silver down about 22.7% over the history window. Possible drivers include movements in the US dollar and rupee, import duty changes, and festive or wedding buying, though the data does not confirm any single cause.
outlook: Prices are close to the lower end of the last 34 days, so there is no urgency: consider buying in smaller amounts and checking the making charges and GST on your bill before you commit.
